questions.q: Who plays both the game hero G.One and his creator in Ra.One?
questions.why: Shah Rukh Khan has a dual role: the game designer Shekhar Subramaniam and his steel-blue hero G.One.

questions.q: What is the name of the game designer whose face G.One borrows?
questions.why: Shekhar, a designer at Barron Industries, lends his face to the protagonist of his own video game.

questions.q: Which colour is G.One's suit, compared with the villain's red?
questions.why: The physical costumes were steel blue for the hero and red for his rival Ra.One.

questions.q: Who works with the boy to bring G.One to life in the real world?
questions.why: Jenny, the programmer behind the tech that moves digital objects into reality, helps Prateek activate G.One.

questions.q: In Ra.One, which device gives both hero and villain their powers and keeps them from being killed?
questions.why: Each character's H.A.R.T. grants powers; destroying it is the only way to kill them.

questions.q: Which boy does G.One protect after he enters the real world?
questions.why: Prateek, the creator's son, bonds with G.One and ends up controlling him in the final fight.

questions.q: Which superstar appears as Chitti the Robot in Ra.One, only as a computer-generated likeness?
questions.why: Rajinikanth was unavailable, so his Chitti cameo was built digitally.

questions.q: Who narrates the video game inside Ra.One?
questions.why: Amitabh Bachchan voices the game's narration; Sanjay Dutt and Priyanka Chopra cameo in other bits.

questions.q: In which year was the film Ra.One, featuring G.One, released?
questions.why: Ra.One reached Indian screens on 26 October 2011, around Diwali.
Anubhav Sinha wrote and directed the film, produced by Gauri Khan's Red Chillies Entertainment.
